sources.title: Vanicléia Silva Santos, African women and the Lisbon Inquisition: Crispina Peres in seventeenth-century Cacheu (2021)
sources.note: Author-uploaded full text of Politeia 20(1), pp. 67 to 95, DOI 10.22481/politeia.v20i1.9179. Directly read. Trial evidence is interpreted critically; accusations of witchcraft are not treated as facts.

sources.title: Manfred Stoppok, Public Electricity Supply in Portuguese Guinea, 1930 to 1974 (2025)
sources.note: Directly read publisher PDF. Printed pp. 107 to 109, especially footnote 30, establish the 1879 administrative separation, 1914 unsuccessful tender and 1930 public networks. No unsupported claim about the first electric lamp.

sources.title: Manuel Teixeira, Cacheu fort, Heritage of Portuguese Influence
sources.note: Original institutional entry verified through indexed full text; subsequent direct fetch failed. Dates the surviving fort to 1641 to 1647; square about 20 metres, corner bastions, walls about 4 to 5 metres high.

sources.title: Joana Sousa and colleagues, Rice Margins Under Climate Change: Labour and Knowledge in Mangrove Rice Networks in Guinea-Bissau (2025)
sources.note: Directly read original article. Historical discussion cites Almada (sixteenth-century account, 1961 edition p. 36) and Rodney 1970 p. 17. Contemporary village gender roles are not projected backward.

sources.title: Lourenço Ocuni Cá, Education during Portuguese colonization in Guinea-Bissau
sources.note: Directly read 19-page PDF, especially PDF p. 5. PDF dated October 2000; journal website gives later online publication. Used for community learning, not a claim that all precolonial education lacked writing or schools.

sources.title: Arquivo Histórico Ultramarino, partial catalogue of the Guinea series, AHU_CU_049
sources.note: Official archival catalogue, indexed original entries 20 and 22 on printed p. 7 directly read. Summaries of 1641 correspondence, not independently deciphered manuscript images.

sources.title: José Manuel Fernandes, Bolama Town Hall, Heritage of Portuguese Influence
sources.note: Complete indexed original entry read; direct fetch failed. Commissioned in 1919, 43 metres long, ten Tuscan columns, staircase and sheltered rear balcony. Commission date is not asserted to be completion date.

sources.title: Honório Pereira Barreto, Memoria sobre o estado actual de Senegambia portugueza (1843)
sources.note: Digitized original book catalogue, indexed title and bibliographic details directly checked: Typ. da Viuva Coelho, 1843, 49 pages. Sample uses catalogue-transcribed historical title; no claim of independent title-page image transcription. Translation supplied literally.

sources.title: Presidency of Portugal, Declaration recognizing the independence of Guinea-Bissau, 10 September 1974
sources.note: Directly read official text signed 10 September and published 11 September 1974. Current runtime reuse is included in the accompanying budget check.
